stories.title: Lamar headed to IR with 'potentially' season-ending thumb injury
stories.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson needs to have surgery on his injured right thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, coach Jesse Minter said.

stories.title: Sources: Oklahoma fires OC Arbuckle after less than two seasons
stories.summary: Oklahoma has fired offensive coordinator Ben Arbuckle after less than two seasons, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel on Monday.

stories.title: FSU interim, alum Stockstill: Noles program dented, not broken
stories.summary: Florida State interim coach Rick Stockstill, who played for the school under Bobby Bowden, says that while the Seminoles program has "got some dents" it's "not broke."
